title: Pan-European Survey on the Under Treatment of Hypercholesterolemia
brief_summary: The survey try to establish the proportion of patients on lipid-lowering pharmacological treatment reaching the LDL-C goals according to the Third Joint European Task Force guidelines, overall and by country.·
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients had to be on a lipid-lowering drug treatment for at least 3 months, with no dose change for a minimum of 6 weeks.
